## CarriedOf type

The attributes a ref of entity `N` may carry, by name.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type CarriedOf<E extends Entities, N extends keyof E> = E[N] extends Entity<infer _K, infer C, infer _X, infer _KIn> ? C : never;
```
